name: Progress
description: A bar showing how far along a task is, or that something is working when the amount is unknown.

label.description: What is progressing, e.g. 'Uploading report.pdf'. It is the accessible name.

value.description: Current value between minValue and maxValue. Leave out with isIndeterminate.

isIndeterminate.description: The amount is unknown: shows a full, pulsing bar and no number.

showValue.description: Shows the percentage (or valueLabel) beside the label.

valueLabel.description: Replaces the percentage in text and for screen readers, e.g. '3 of 10 files'.

variant.description: Bar color. Say it in the label too: color alone isn't enough.

requirements: Exposes aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax, or none of them when indeterminate
The bar color has 3:1 contrast against the track
The pulsing indeterminate animation stops for people who prefer reduced motion
screenReader: Announced as a progress bar with its name and percentage
An indeterminate bar is announced as busy, without a value

avoid_when: A short wait with no meaningful progress: use a spinner
A value that is not progress toward something: use a meter
anti_patterns: Danger color for something that is only slow
